name: Dalaran Crater
summary: The Dalaran Crater marks the historic site where the magocratic city-state of Dalaran once stood beside the waters of Lordamere Lake. In the wake of its destruction during the Third War, a colossal, glowing violet protective shield now shrouds the rebuilding ruins from the outside world. Outside the barrier, surviving Kirin Tor sorcerers and bound elementals stand vigilant watch against trespassers.

sections.title: A City Behind the Shroud
sections.body: Before the Third War, Dalaran was a radiant bastion of arcane mastery, its spires reflecting off the waters of Lordamere Lake. When the demon lord Archimonde invaded Lordaeron, he laid waste to the city, reducing its glittering towers to rubble. In the aftermath, the surviving magi of the Kirin Tor rallied under leadership including Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver, returning to their ancestral grounds to rebuild. To protect their efforts from lingering Scourge, predatory monsters, and the expanding reach of the Forsaken, the Kirin Tor erected an impenetrable, opaque purple bubble of magical force. Behind this shield, the work of restoration continues hidden from mortal eyes.

sections.title: Sentinels of the Perimeter
sections.body: The perimeter surrounding the dome is heavily patrolled by Dalaran wizards and bound rock elementals. While the magi remain sympathetic and hospitable toward travelers of the Alliance, they treat members of the Horde as hostile intruders. Those attempting to reach the dome will find the shimmering barrier completely unyielding to physical entry, sealing off the heart of the magocracy until the Kirin Tor deems their city ready to face the world once more.

faq.q: What is the giant purple bubble on the edge of Lordamere Lake?
faq.answer: It is an opaque arcane force field erected by the surviving Kirin Tor. Following the destruction of Dalaran in the Third War, the magi cast this protective barrier over their ruined city to guard their reconstruction efforts from outside threats.

faq.q: Can players enter the Dalaran dome?
faq.answer: No. The magical barrier is entirely solid and impassable to adventurers. The city inside is completely sealed off while the Kirin Tor works behind the curtain.

faq.q: Why are the wizards here hostile to the Horde?
aliases: why do dalaran mages attack horde
faq.answer: The Kirin Tor maintains strong historic ties to the Alliance of Lordaeron. Furthermore, with the Forsaken claiming the surrounding kingdom and clashing with surviving human forces, the wizards do not permit Horde champions anywhere near their defensive shield.

angles.text: Standing before the great dome is a solemn pilgrimage: the heart of arcane study in the Eastern Kingdoms lies devastated, but the enduring barrier proves the Kirin Tor are far from vanquished.
The wizards stationed along the perimeter welcome Alliance champions, offering a rare point of allied strength amid the hostile borders of Silverpine and Hillsbrad.
